article.title: Where Do Superprofits Come From? On the Nature of Digital Capitalism
article.author: Tony Andréani
article.content: Digital capitalism is merely a new form of exploitation that has become widespread by spilling out of the company itself to encompass the mass of its users or customers. The post Where Do Superprofits Come From? On the Nature of Digital Capitalism appeared first on MR Online .
